stage_schedule.title: {stage}: {device} ({position}/{count})
stage_schedule.description:
How should **{device}** (`{entity_id}`) behave during this stage?

- **Time window** uses on/off time (windows may cross midnight).
- **Interval** uses on-for / every, repeating from midnight.
- **Not managed** leaves the device alone.

remove_stage.title: Remove a stage
remove_stage.description: Choose the stage to remove. Nothing is deleted until you save the plan.

tasks.title: Edit tasks
tasks.description: Choose the stage whose tasks you want to edit.

data_description.days: Day of the stage (day 1 is the day the stage starts). Several days are separated by commas, e.g. "1, 4, 7".
data_description.every: Optional. Repeats the task every N days, starting on the first day.
data_description.until: Optional. Last day of the repeat; defaults to the end of the stage.
data_description.method: For trimming and plant training, e.g. "Topping" or "LST".
